item.text: {"analysis":"BPR-max trial completed successfully but reduced macro validation HR@10 to 0.5138, versus 0.5375 for the preceding sampled-softmax model and the recorded best of 0.5400. Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.5200, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.5750, Electronics 0.4350, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.5250. This result does not support replacing sampled softmax with this BPR-max configuration; it does not establish why performance declined. Deterministic numerical checks passed, so numerical correctness alone did not ensure improved ranking. No test results were available.","code_summary":"One independently trained GRURec per category: two-layer 128-dimensional GRU, projected gated causal attention, tied item embeddings, and jointly trained item biases. BPR-max uses 1,024 shared uniform negative draws, training-window collision masking, and a 0.001 softmax-weighted squared-negative-score penalty. Training retains AdamW, seed 42, validation checkpoint selection, and early stopping. The predictor embeds the exact architecture and strictly loads one selected checkpoint for each category, with no ensembles or auxiliary fitted scorers."}
